newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Optic phone cable links Bulgaria and Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: Optic phone cable links Bulgaria and Macedonia.

text.p: Bulgaria and Macedonia on Thursday launched an optic telephone link between Sofia and the Macedonian town of Kriva Palanka as part of a Trans-Balkan telecom route connecting Western Europe with the Middle East.

Bulgaria's state news agency BTA said Posts and Communications Committee chairman Lyubomir Kolarov and Macedonia's transport and communications minister Dimitar Buzlevski have also opened officially an overlay link from Sofia to the southwestern Bulgarian town of Kyustendil.

Telecommunications officials said the 20-km (12.5 mile) stretch from Kyustendil via the border checkpoint of Gjueshevo to Kriva Palanka is part of a planned route from Brindisi in Italy through Albania, Macedonia, and Bulgaria to Istanbul in Turkey.
The link will improve the quality of telephone services between the two Balkan neighbours, they added.
